Miners prefer GPUs because they have higher computational power and canmake cryptographic calculationsfaster. To mine litecoins, you also need to download the appropriate software. You may find it difficult to mine litecoins on your own. In this case, you can just join a mining pool, where you can just relax and earn your rewards. In case of Litecoin, thereward reduces by half every time 840,000 blocks are mined. Currently,miners can earn 25 litecoins for every blockthey create and this reward halves after a particular number of blocks are created. Dash is one of the newest kinds on block. It is an anonymous coin that currently enjoysa market cap of over $1 billion. EachDash coin is today worthmore than $200. It works on the principles of proof of work and the blockchain technology. Dash recommends ASIC processors for mining its coins, but miners can still use their CPUs and GPUs for mining Dash coins. Detailed mining guides are available on the Dash website. Going through those guides will help you find a faster hashrate on your CPU. If you are into GPU mining, you have to download appropriate software such asDashMiner,MinerGate, andSGMiner. You also need to install a wallet to store all your Dash coins. You can make things easier for you by just joining a mining pool as it will greatly increase your chances of earning rewards. Dash blocks are hard to generate as they useX11 algorithms. If thehashrate is 385 Mh/s, you will get 1.8 Dash coins per blockgenerated. You have to use CPUs and GPUs to mine Monero coins asno ASIC equipment has been created for Monero so far. You must use AMD graphic cards although NVidia GPUs work just as well. You also need to use appropriate software such as the CryptoCompare-recommended Wolf’s Cryptonote Open Source CPU Miner. It has an AMD GPU version for those using AMD GPU, calledWolf’s Cryptonote Open Source AMD GPU Miner. The next step is to configure your software to make it work with the hardware, install a Monero wallet, join a cryptocurrency mining pool, and collect your rewards. news_title: FlexiNetAI Pioneers Blockchain Adoption with AI Integration Across Industries
news_content: FlexiNetAI is reshaping how industries adopt blockchain by integrating artificial intelligence (AI) within a versatile platform designed to serve sectors ranging from education and finance to healthcare, energy, and government. By combining blockchain’s transparency with AI’s analytical power, FlexiNetAI aims to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and secure data across various applications. The platform’s adaptability and emphasis on real-world applications position it as a valuable tool for modernizing systems and enabling blockchain’s adoption beyond the tech realm. In the education sector, FlexiNetAI offers solutions that make academic record-keeping more secure and transparent. By storing academic data—such as grades, certifications, and degrees—on blockchain, the platform ensures that records are tamper-proof and easily accessible to educational institutions and employers worldwide. Through AI-enhanced analytics, FlexiNetAI can identify patterns in students’ learning and offer personalized educational recommendations, allowing teachers to adjust their methods for optimal student engagement. Additionally, administrative tasks such as tuition payments and scholarship management are simplified with smart contracts, reducing the operational load on institutions. FlexiNetAI is making strides in the finance industry by enabling more efficient payment processing, asset management, and risk assessment. AI-driven analytics allow financial institutions to evaluate risk more precisely and generate tailored investment advice. Meanwhile, blockchain’s transparency and smart contract automation simplify complex transactions, reducing the need for manual processes and enhancing accuracy. By using FlexiNetAI’s platform, financial institutions can lower costs, increase transaction speeds, and improve data security, accelerating their transition toward digital, blockchain-enabled finance. The healthcare sector stands to benefit significantly from FlexiNetAI’s blockchain-based platform, which facilitates secure sharing of patient data across medical providers. The platform allows patient information to be stored and accessed without compromising privacy, enabling seamless sharing between institutions. FlexiNetAI’s AI tools analyze medical data to support accurate diagnoses and customized treatment plans, offering enhanced precision in patient care. Additionally, automated smart contracts streamline essential processes such as insurance claims and prescription management, helping healthcare providers focus on patient care while reducing administrative costs. In the energy industry, FlexiNetAI optimizes resource management and market efficiency through predictive AI algorithms and blockchain-backed smart contracts. By forecasting energy demand, the platform enables suppliers to allocate resources effectively and adjust to market shifts proactively. Smart contracts automate energy trade and transaction processes, improving transparency, reducing delays, and ultimately cutting costs. These advances support energy providers in boosting sustainability and maintaining clearer, more efficient market operations. FlexiNetAI’s platform also brings considerable advancements to supply chain management, enabling comprehensive tracking of products from raw material acquisition to final delivery. By recording every stage of the supply chain on blockchain, the platform ensures that records are both transparent and secure, helping companies mitigate fraud, errors, and inefficiencies. For government operations, FlexiNetAI provides a secure platform for managing public records, including land ownership and identity verification. Smart contracts simplify voting, benefit distribution, and other administrative tasks, while AI-driven data analysis aids in making informed decisions and optimizing public services. As FlexiNetAI expands its range of applications across industries, its platform continues to attract diverse users, fostering a collaborative ecosystem. With an open and scalable architecture, the platform invites developers and businesses to create customized blockchain applications that fit their specific needs. Partnering with industry leaders, FlexiNetAI ensures that its technology remains relevant and adapts to changing market demands, driving technological growth and encouraging blockchain adoption in mainstream applications. Looking forward, FlexiNetAI’s expanding ecosystem signifies its influence on global industry adoption of blockchain and AI. By equipping various sectors with tools for efficiency, security, and transparency, FlexiNetAI solidifies its role in advancing blockchain technology and supporting a global shift toward a digital economy. Its commitment to collaboration, real-world applications, and continuous innovation positions FlexiNetAI as a pivotal contributor to a more connected and transparent future across education, finance, healthcare, energy, and government. news_title: HSBC Targets Metaverse Investments with New Fund for Wealthy Clients
news_content: HSBC Holdings has introduced a fund specifically designed to seize investment opportunities in the metaverse for its affluent clients in Hong Kong and Singapore. This move aligns with the growing trend of financial services companies tapping into Silicon Valley’s burgeoning virtual reality sector. In a statement released on Wednesday, HSBC outlined that its Metaverse Discretionary Strategy portfolio, managed by its asset management division, will concentrate on investments within the metaverse ecosystem across five key segments: infrastructure, computing, virtualization, experience and discovery, and interface. This comprehensive approach aims to capture the diverse opportunities presented by the rapidly evolving metaverse landscape. Lina Lim, regional head of discretionary and funds for investments and wealth solutions in Asia Pacific at HSBC, commented on the dynamic nature of the metaverse ecosystem, emphasizing the influx of companies from various industries and sizes into this space. Lim noted that despite being in its early stages, the metaverse is witnessing rapid development, creating numerous exciting opportunities for investors. The metaverse represents a network of virtual environments accessible via multiple devices, where users can work, socialize, and play. Interest in this sector has surged since Facebook rebranded itself as Meta, signaling its strategic focus on virtual reality. HSBC’s new discretionary portfolio is tailored for high net worth and ultra-high net worth professional investors, as well as accredited investor clients in Hong Kong and Singapore. This strategic initiative reflects HSBC’s commitment to providing innovative investment solutions to its wealthiest clients. In addition to launching the new fund, HSBC announced last month its purchase of virtual real estate in an online gaming space, making it the second global bank to invest in a popular metaverse platform following JPMorgan’s establishment of a presence in the blockchain-based Decentraland. This investment is part of HSBC’s broader strategy to allocate $3.5 billion into its wealth and personal banking business. This significant investment aligns with HSBC’s ambition to become the leading wealth manager in Asia by 2025. The move to invest in the metaverse and virtual real estate is a reflection of the broader trend among global wealth managers, including UBS and Credit Suisse, who are increasing their presence in Asia. This region has seen a substantial rise in the number of billionaires and millionaires, particularly in countries like China and India. These developments underscore the competitive landscape in wealth management, with firms vying to capture the growing wealth in Asia. In conclusion, HSBC’s launch of the Metaverse Discretionary Strategy portfolio marks a significant step in its efforts to harness the potential of the metaverse for its wealthy clients. By focusing on key segments of the metaverse ecosystem and making strategic investments in virtual real estate, HSBC is positioning itself at the forefront of this emerging sector. The bank’s commitment to investing in its wealth and personal banking business further highlights its ambition to lead the wealth management industry in Asia, capitalizing on the region’s rapidly increasing affluence. news_content: If you do have any quantity of any digital currencies then the fastest and most convenient way for you to sell your holdings is by making use of a digital currency exchange, however what many people have been complaining about is there being some very long delays in their sell orders being processed at many different digital currency exchanges. news_title: Chainlink Unveils CRE: Boosting Blockchain Scalability and Customization
news_content: Chainlink has introduced a transformative upgrade called the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE), a new platform designed to scale operations across thousands of blockchain networks while providing developers with flexible and customizable workflows. The update, shared through Chainlink’s official X account, represents a step forward in modular blockchain design by breaking down essential oracle functions into adaptable components, allowing developers to create more specialized workflows suited to individual application requirements. The CRE offers a modular and composable architecture that enables developers to tap into Chainlink’s capabilities in unique ways. By separating the fundamental functions of an oracle network—such as blockchain reading and API calling—into distinct modules, Chainlink allows developers to integrate these functions based on their specific project needs. This architecture forms the foundation of Chainlink’s ecosystem, centralizing its capabilities in a way that allows for innovative workflows triggered by decentralized oracle networks (DONs) to securely facilitate interactions across various blockchain environments. An especially appealing aspect of CRE is its support for self-serve product development. Through this upgrade, developers can design applications and processes on the platform without needing to embed specialized Chainlink code into core blockchain computations. This makes cross-blockchain communication and transactions easier for developers to implement and enhances the platform’s usability, particularly for teams seeking a more seamless way to manage cross-chain data flows and interactions. In addition to fostering more customized development, CRE’s architecture accommodates programmatic workflows, which can be adjusted for specific blockchain applications. The platform also supports standard programming languages and tools, along with standardized cross-chain components, making it more accessible for a broader audience of developers. This cross-chain functionality opens new avenues for applications that benefit from diverse blockchain networks while maintaining ease of interaction.  Introducing Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE)—a major platform upgrade: 🔌 New modular, composable architecture⛓️ Scalable across 1000s of chains🏦 Deep customization for capital markets users🏗️ Self-serve product development 🧵⬇️https://t.co/BE807PgfB2 — Chainlink (@chainlink)October 30, 2024  To protect the user experience, Chainlink has structured the CRE upgrade as a phased rollout. This staggered approach will help the platform maintain continuity for current users throughout the transition. In the initial phase, Chainlink will focus on migrating key services such as the Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) to the CRE foundation. This move is expected to strengthen Chainlink’s cross-chain infrastructure, allowing for more seamless scalability as additional blockchains are integrated. As part of this upgrade, Chainlink has also introduced new blockchain integrations, including support for the Aptos blockchain. This enhanced architecture allows financial institutions to connect their existing systems with blockchain-based workflows, such as Delivery vs. Payment (DvP). By joining the early access program for CRE, users interested in exploring workflow creation on this platform can contribute to Chainlink’s growing network of cross-chain applications. The CRE upgrade thus not only benefits current users but also extends Chainlink’s reach into sectors looking for advanced interoperability solutions. Chainlink’s introduction of CRE is a significant leap forward for both the platform and its users. By providing a flexible, modular environment that facilitates blockchain interactions across various networks, CRE underscores Chainlink’s commitment to scalability and innovation within the blockchain space. This update, with its emphasis on modular design and cross-chain capabilities, positions Chainlink as a leading solution for developers seeking interoperability without compromising on customization or security. Ultimately, the Chainlink Runtime Environment stands as a promising development in blockchain technology, allowing developers to build applications that cater to diverse, decentralized workflows while simplifying the complexities of cross-chain data exchange. Through CRE, Chainlink continues to evolve as a platform that enables not only decentralized finance but also a broader ecosystem of blockchain-powered applications tailored to specific business and industry requirements. news_title: Morph Launches on Ethereum, Targeting Mass Blockchain Adoption
news_content: Morph, a globally recognized platform for advancing blockchain adoption, has officially launched its mainnet on Ethereum, a significant development in its journey toward creating a blockchain experience that is accessible to mainstream users. The launch of the Morph mainnet introduces a consumer layer designed to overcome common adoption barriers by enabling participants to trade real assets and engage in various blockchain transactions. With the mainnet now live, projects already developed on Morph can seamlessly transition to this broader ecosystem, potentially increasing user engagement and accelerating the platform’s consumer-focused growth. CEO and co-founder Cecilia Hsueh emphasized that this mainnet launch is a major achievement in Morph’s goal to bring blockchain technology to a broad audience. She indicated that most decentralized applications (DApps) are currently inaccessible to everyday users and stated that Morph’s objective is to bridge this gap by providing a decentralized, scalable, and secure infrastructure. This will enable developers to create the next generation of user-friendly DApps and offer non-crypto natives the opportunity to interact easily within the blockchain ecosystem. Morph’s consumer layer is a comprehensive environment combining advanced blockchain technologies, such as optimistic and zero-knowledge (ZK) rollups, which improve both security and scalability. The solution is crafted to address longstanding issues in blockchain, including regulatory restrictions, scalability limitations, and performance challenges. With these improvements, Morph is striving to make blockchain accessible to a wider user base by offering builders an experience that prioritizes scalability, security, and simplicity. Morph’s mainnet debut builds on the successes of its earlier Holesky testnet, which featured several key upgrades that have been integrated into the mainnet. One notable advancement was the EIP-4844 Optimistic zkVM integration, a feature that reduces transaction costs and offers an updated bridge mechanism allowing for single-transaction withdrawals. During the testnet phase, Morph recorded substantial engagement, with over six million wallet addresses, more than 100 million transactions, 200 projects deployed, and over one million community members. This high level of activity highlights the network’s appeal to developers and users alike and lays a strong foundation for further adoption on the mainnet. COO and co-founder Azeem Khan highlighted that Morph’s goal is to be a comprehensive resource for global builders, providing them with tools to help them achieve success in launching and scaling their blockchain projects. He pointed out that while decentralization is critical, builders face challenges in finding the resources needed for successful project development, launch, and expansion. Morph aims to address this gap by creating an environment tailored to the needs of builders, thereby facilitating a more accessible path to blockchain success. Morph distinguishes itself from other blockchain platforms by prioritizing a consumer-focused approach rather than remaining limited to purely technical features. This consumer layer strategy involves offering critical resources to builders, including funding, incubation, acceleration, and market strategies, all aimed at fostering a user-first approach to blockchain development. Among its initiatives, Morph recently launched the Centralized Exchange Coalition, which includes several leading centralized exchanges, to empower builders with the tools necessary to bring projects to market, attract new users, and secure essential funding. Through these supportive measures, Morph seeks to position itself as a significant driver of blockchain innovation and adoption, facilitating a new wave of user-friendly applications that can appeal to a broad audience. This support system aligns with Morph’s overarching vision of transforming the blockchain industry from a niche technological space to an accessible mainstream utility. By equipping builders with the necessary resources, Morph aims to generate a broad ecosystem of applications that meet diverse user needs and contribute to increased blockchain adoption. Morph operates as a global consumer layer, serving as a distribution hub that provides builders with the resources needed to launch and scale their projects for the mass market. Through the use of hybrid rollup technology, combining ZK and Optimistic rollups, and employing a decentralized sequencer, Morph opens up limitless possibilities for developers targeting a mainstream audience. This unique blend of technology allows Morph to offer a user-friendly experience for developers who seek to create accessible and secure blockchain applications. As one of Morph’s original investors, Bitget, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, will continue to play a role in supporting the Morph ecosystem and contributing to its growth. With these strategic partnerships and innovative technologies, Morph is positioned to make a significant impact on the blockchain industry by paving the way for consumer-friendly, scalable applications that cater to everyday users. By emphasizing accessibility, resource support, and advanced technology, Morph aims to transform the blockchain landscape and drive a new era of blockchain adoption for all. news_title: Instruxi Launches Mesh ID to Simplify Secure Access to Tokenized Assets
news_content: Instruxi, an emerging decentralized data management platform, has introduced Mesh ID, its latest Web3 solution aimed at revolutionizing access to tokenized Real-World Assets (RWAs) for over 22 million U.S. residents. This innovative tool is designed to simplify identity verification processes, enhance data privacy, and improve user accessibility to blockchain-based financial products in a way that aligns with regulatory requirements. Instruxi has collaborated with prominent industry players, including Chainlink, CLEAR, and Space and Time, to launch the Mesh ID solution as the initial module of its RWA platform. This collaboration, announced via a recent press release, leverages each partner’s strengths to optimize identity verification and provide robust data security for blockchain applications. Mesh ID integrates with CLEAR’s advanced API, enabling streamlined know-your-customer (KYC) processing without compromising user privacy or security. With CLEAR’s established track record of serving over 25 million users, Instruxi’s solution stands to benefit from a reputable, tier-one identity verification system. The Instruxi-CLEAR partnership facilitates faster pre-approval and minimizes KYC processing times, ultimately making on-chain financial products more accessible to U.S.-based users while ensuring regulatory compliance. In addition to CLEAR, Chainlink brings substantial value to Instruxi’s platform. As a leading decentralized computing platform, Chainlink supports Mesh ID’s seamless integration with enterprise systems, offering both on-chain and off-chain security assurances. Chainlink’s extensive suite of Oracle services has been pivotal in enabling secure data interactions, a key factor in asset tokenization’s projected $867 trillion market potential. Instruxi employs Chainlink Functions to enable access to real-world data via APIs and utilizes Chainlink Automation to ensure efficient, scalable operations within a decentralized framework. Further strengthening Mesh ID’s infrastructure, Instruxi has collaborated with Space and Time, a decentralized data warehouse for blockchain applications. Space and Time’s zero-knowledge database enables users to verify elements of their data and identity without exposing sensitive details on-chain. This feature enhances security while facilitating privacy-conscious access to RWAs, aligning with Instruxi’s mission to uphold data confidentiality as a cornerstone of its offerings. Austin Przybysz, Instruxi’s Co-Founder and Solutions Architect, highlighted the importance of the Mesh ID beta release, noting that this collaboration integrates KYC and identity verification within Instruxi Data Mesh to enable universal policy enforcement capabilities across the platform. He underscored the significance of combining high standards of user security with regulatory compliance to broaden accessibility to tokenized assets in a seamless, compliant manner. With the launch of Mesh ID, Instruxi is positioning itself at the forefront of asset tokenization, starting with tokenized real estate assets for its closed beta users. As the platform moves toward its full release, the company plans to expand its asset offerings to include additional classes, aligning with its goal to make a broad range of tokenized RWAs available through a user-centric, decentralized platform. Real-World Assets, or RWAs, refer to digital tokens that represent traditional financial assets, including cash, securities, commodities, and real estate, on the blockchain. By converting these assets into blockchain-based tokens, users gain new benefits such as fractional ownership, programmability, enhanced liquidity, transparency, and improved risk management. This emerging sector is gaining traction, with projections estimating a valuation of $10 trillion by 2030. Instruxi’s Mesh ID release signals a step toward a future where blockchain technology provides enhanced access to real-world financial assets in a way that preserves data privacy, streamlines verification processes, and ensures regulatory compliance. Through collaborations with industry leaders like Chainlink, CLEAR, and Space and Time, Instruxi demonstrates a commitment to creating an ecosystem where decentralized finance and real-world assets can coexist securely and efficiently. With Mesh ID’s launch, the platform takes a crucial step toward transforming how users interact with and access tokenized assets, setting a promising course for the future of Web3 applications in asset management. Industry observers attribute part of this growth to the recent approval of Ethereum spot ETFs, which has boosted investor confidence and helped cement Ethereum’s place as a key financial asset. news_title: Deadfellaz and Skale Labs Partner for Gas-Free NFT Trading Card Game Launch
news_content: In a strategic step towards mainstream adoption of blockchain gaming, Skale Labs has collaborated with DFZ Labs, the creative force behind the successful Deadfellaz NFT collection, to introduce an innovative trading card game (TCG) called Death Touch. Expected to launch in the first quarter of 2025, this new game will be accessible on mobile devices, positioning it to attract a broad range of users and serve as an entry point for a more mainstream audience into blockchain gaming. The Deadfellaz NFT collection originally debuted on Ethereum in August 2021, crafted by co-founders Psych and Betty, and quickly gained traction due to its unique themes and early endorsement by high-profile figures, including Reese Witherspoon, Steve Aoki, Bill Murray, and Reddit co-founder Alexis Ohanian. The collection’s rise in popularity underscored the appeal of digital collectibles with strong community elements, which the founders are now extending into a mobile trading card game format. Skale Labs, known for its scalable, gas-free blockchain solutions, currently supports a network of over 150 games in various development stages within its ecosystem. The recent partnership with DFZ Labs builds upon this base by leveraging Skale’s infrastructure to optimize Death Touch for accessibility and performance. As a gas-free Ethereum scaling solution, Skale’s blockchain facilitates more user-friendly experiences, which are crucial for attracting casual and competitive gamers alike. This partnership also reflects Skale’s broader strategic objectives, following a recent collaboration with gaming pioneer Nolan Bushnell—founder of Atari—whose gaming tournament platform, Moxy, is set to integrate with Skale’s infrastructure. According to Andrew Saunders, Chief Marketing and Growth Officer at Skale Labs, integrating the Deadfellaz franchise within the Skale ecosystem aligns with Skale’s mission to prioritize consumer-friendly applications of blockchain. He expressed his enthusiasm for seeing blockchain gaming projects like Deadfellaz actively working toward broader consumer adoption. Saunders highlighted the growth potential in a gaming landscape that he sees as evolving toward greater consumer focus rather than being purely brand-driven. He further noted that having followed Deadfellaz closely since its inception, he felt optimistic about their expansion into new gaming genres. By building a mobile-first title that embraces the trading card game genre, DFZ Labs aims to offer a more dynamic and engaging experience for fans seeking fresh interactions within the TCG space. He emphasized that partnering with Skale would enable Death Touch to grow as a free-to-play title, providing a seamless experience for both Web3 gamers and traditional gamers. The gas-free structure of Skale’s blockchain, he noted, allows them to reach a wider demographic, including competitive players and casual users who may be new to blockchain-based games. The collaboration between Skale Labs and DFZ Labs is set against a larger trend of integrating blockchain technology within the gaming industry. With projects like Death Touch, these partnerships are moving closer to offering scalable, user-friendly platforms for gaming experiences that combine digital collectibles with gameplay. By addressing key pain points such as transaction fees, Skale’s gas-free blockchain approach makes it easier for developers to target a mainstream audience, potentially bridging the gap between blockchain gaming enthusiasts and traditional gaming communities. Through the creation of this new TCG, Skale Labs and DFZ Labs are not only building upon the Deadfellaz brand but are also aiming to redefine user interaction within Web3 applications. This partnership signals a step towards making blockchain gaming more accessible and engaging, ensuring players experience the benefits of blockchain without the common obstacles associated with it. With the anticipated launch of Death Touch, Skale Labs and DFZ Labs appear poised to bring blockchain gaming to an even broader market, pushing the boundaries of interactive digital experiences and setting a new precedent for community-driven gaming in the Web3 space. news_title: Ubisoft Quietly Launches Blockchain Game Champions Tactics
news_content: Ubisoft, a prominent player in the gaming industry, has officially entered the blockchain arena with the release of its first blockchain-based game, Champions Tactics: Grimoria Chronicles. This new title introduces a tactical, turn-based experience incorporating NFTs (non-fungible tokens) as key in-game assets. Initially announced by the company in June, Champions Tactics represents a significant development following Ubisoft’s ongoing blockchain experimentation, yet the release itself was relatively low-profile. Available for PC, the game is free to start, though players have the option to purchase NFT figurines—digital assets with unique attributes—using either in-game currency or cryptocurrency on an integrated marketplace. The game showcases Ubisoft’s approach to combining collectible digital items with innovative gameplay. The gameplay model in Champions Tactics focuses on turn-based battles where players face off using teams of three figurines, each with distinct characteristics. While it’s possible to participate in the game without purchasing any of these NFTs, the option is available to those willing to invest in them, with prices for these unique figurines varying widely on the marketplace from $7 to as high as $64,000. These collectible NFTs provide a significant advantage in gameplay, allowing for deeper engagement and competition among players. Ubisoft’s Strategic Innovation Lab collaborated with Oasys to design Champions Tactics with a focus on integrating blockchain in a way that enhances the gaming experience. According to Ubisoft’s Paris studio director, François Bodson, the game introduces innovative features that mirror traditional trading card games but with unique digital assets under player control. The blockchain foundation, he added, was used to create “new and innovative” gaming experiences, providing players with enhanced agency and ownership over their assets. Each NFT figurine, procedurally generated and unique in its attributes, provides strategic depth and flexibility as players can shape their assets and teams through player-driven choices. The design includes an open marketplace for players to build squads using a peer-to-peer model. During the game’s development, Ubisoft actively sought community feedback through events and beta phases, ensuring that player insights contributed to the evolution of Champions Tactics. Ubisoft intends to continue refining and expanding the game based on community engagement, as the game’s blockchain-enabled infrastructure allows for adaptability and growth. While the Adult Only rating for the game wasn’t addressed directly by Ubisoft, it is likely tied to the game’s use of blockchain elements and cryptocurrency-based transactions. In addition to its blockchain debut, Ubisoft previously ventured into the NFT space with Quartz, a dedicated NFT platform launched in December 2021. Initially, this project involved NFT offerings for Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Breakpoint, but it encountered limited success, with only a small number of NFTs sold. Despite these early challenges, Ubisoft executives maintained that the potential for player-driven value in blockchain assets held promise, even though initial reception was lukewarm. Ubisoft’s dedication to blockchain persisted despite these setbacks and contrasts with the more cautious or skeptical stance other industry players have adopted toward cryptocurrency in gaming. Within the broader gaming landscape, there has been a noticeable shift in blockchain enthusiasm. Even Electronic Arts (EA), which once expressed interest in NFTs as an essential part of gaming’s future, has since stepped back, adopting a wait-and-see approach. EA’s CEO Andrew Wilson had previously highlighted the enduring appeal of collectible items in gaming, though he emphasized that NFT integration was not an immediate focus for the company. He suggested that NFT integration would only be explored further if it aligned with EA’s core mission of enhancing player experiences. Ubisoft’s release of Champions Tactics: Grimoria Chronicles therefore stands out in the industry, as other major companies scale back on blockchain plans amid uncertain player reception. In choosing to launch Champions Tactics, Ubisoft reinforces its commitment to blockchain exploration, placing a long-term bet on digital collectibles and player-controlled assets as part of its strategy. With this title, Ubisoft aims to carve a space in the emerging field of blockchain gaming, leveraging NFTs to create unique gameplay opportunities and a player-driven economy. Whether this approach will resonate with the broader gaming community remains to be seen, but Champions Tactics marks a notable moment in Ubisoft’s digital innovation journey. news_title: G6 Networks Introduces Dual Blockchain Solution for Public and Private Sectors
news_content: G6 Networks has unveiled a dual blockchain framework designed to serve both general users and businesses, offering an adaptable solution that merges the benefits of public and private blockchain ecosystems. This approach involves two distinct components: a public chain for individual users, focusing on decentralization and digital identity, and a private chain intended for organizations with high-security needs, such as those in finance, government, and public services. The recently launched G6 Networks website provides a comprehensive look at the company’s capabilities and future objectives, highlighting upcoming developments such as the Token Fair Launch. This will be followed by the mainnet launch and Token Generation Event (TGE) slated for mid-January, bringing to life various features like decentralized storage, staking, games, and even feeless transactions. This progressive roadmap is part of G6 Networks’ commitment to empowering both individual users and enterprises with tailored blockchain applications that support secure, scalable, and flexible solutions. In an effort to enhance the efficiency and security of enterprise solutions, G6 Networks’ hybrid infrastructure integrates both public and private blockchains. While the public chain is geared toward everyday users with a focus on accessibility and digital identity, the private chain has been designed to meet the specific needs of institutions requiring a permissioned and customizable platform. This structure is ideal for enterprises where data security and scalability are paramount. Examples of sectors benefiting from this private blockchain ecosystem include financial services, government operations, and public sector entities. Additionally, G6 Networks has incorporated an advanced security layer into this infrastructure, which includes a distributed hardware storage system that ensures data resilience and maintains information integrity. One of the standout features of G6 Networks’ architecture is interoperability, a capability that facilitates interaction between different private chains—a rare functionality in blockchain platforms. This interoperability is expected to be especially valuable in fields with strict privacy requirements, such as finance and government. For instance, industries that need secure, inter-departmental communication can leverage this flexible connection feature without compromising sensitive data. To further enhance security, G6 Networks plans to introduce a zero-knowledge proof feature and encrypted data management tools. These additions will ensure that only authorized individuals can access sensitive information, protecting data privacy while maintaining transparency. In both private and public sector applications, G6 Networks aims to address critical needs ranging from digital identity management to financial transparency and secure document storage. G6 Networks co-founders Six and Gabo, who have been long-time ambassadors for Polkadot, shared that the company’s mission revolves around simplifying blockchain technology and making it more accessible to a broader audience. They emphasized that G6 Networks allows businesses and institutions to adopt scalable and efficient blockchain solutions tailored to meet their unique needs. This mission reflects the broader vision of G6 Networks to foster innovation and support sustainable growth in blockchain technology. G6 Networks’ approach to implementation follows a structured, five-phase process, beginning with a needs assessment and extending to long-term maintenance. This strategy ensures that each deployment can adapt to evolving organizational requirements, underscoring the company’s dedication to providing flexible and impactful solutions. Key upcoming milestones, such as the January mainnet launch, are anticipated to significantly expand the functionality available to users, offering tools and features designed to have real-world impact across diverse applications. By combining the security and customizability of private chains with the accessibility and interoperability of public blockchain technologies, G6 Networks aims to deliver a solution that meets a wide range of user requirements. This hybrid model, enriched by future features like feeless transactions, decentralized storage, and encrypted data management, stands out in the current blockchain landscape. With a vision rooted in long-term utility and innovation, G6 Networks is positioned to lead in the development of adaptable blockchain solutions that cater to the unique needs of both individual users and large institutions. news_title: Square’s Patent For Crypto Payment Network Approved
news_content: Square, a leading digital payment company recently announced that it has hit another milestone. Papers recentlypublished by the US Patent & Trademark Office(USPTO) reveal that the office has formally approved of the company’s patent application for a crypto payment system. This will allow merchants to accept cryptocurrency payments from anywhere. Square filed for this patent in September 2017 and it has been close to a year for them to get the required approval. The new patent is not as revolutionary as it seems. Other payment processors likeBitPayhave allowed automatic conversion of cryptocurrencies into local currency before. The main difference is the high level of market penetration that Square has across the globe. Square is a market leaderwhen it comes to point-of-sale (POS) payments and adding cryptocurrency payments to that would be a big advantage. Merchants who already use Square would appreciate the added functionality and it would open a whole new market for cryptocurrencies. The biggest breakthrough that the patent gives to the network is its elimination of latency when it comes to bitcoin transactions. This allows for fasterbitcoin transactions– which is the main barrier to a lot of bitcoin payments. Square does this maintaining its own blockchain network that keeps a record of transactions that are then sent to the public blockchain. This transfers the risk of double spend attacks from the merchant to Square, encouraging merchants to take the risks. Another method by which transaction latency is eliminated is by having user funds held by Square, with Square updating its internal ledgers instead of referring to the external blockchain. However, a patent approval does not mean that Square will be implementing the system any time soon. Other companies have applied for crypto payment patents and have done nothing with them. For example,Bank of Americahas a number of them but the bank does not seem to be planning to use any of them. Square could be different in this regard because CEOJack Dorseyis a big fan of cryptocurrencies and he may want to push for a quick implementation. In a statement, Dorsey said The internet deserves a native currency. It will have a native currency. I don’t know if it will be Bitcoin or not. I hope it will be bitcoin Dorsey also says that Square’s interest in Bitcoin goes beyond just buying and selling it. The Square Cash app already features bitcoin trading, adding a cryptocurrency payment system to the app is a good move if Square really wants to promote bitcoin usage. news_title: Square’s Patent For Crypto Payment Network Approved
news_content: Square, a leading digital payment company recently announced that it has hit another milestone. Papers recentlypublished by the US Patent & Trademark Office(USPTO) reveal that the office has formally approved of the company’s patent application for a crypto payment system. This will allow merchants to accept cryptocurrency payments from anywhere. Square filed for this patent in September 2017 and it has been close to a year for them to get the required approval. The new patent is not as revolutionary as it seems. Other payment processors likeBitPayhave allowed automatic conversion of cryptocurrencies into local currency before. The main difference is the high level of market penetration that Square has across the globe. Square is a market leaderwhen it comes to point-of-sale (POS) payments and adding cryptocurrency payments to that would be a big advantage. Merchants who already use Square would appreciate the added functionality and it would open a whole new market for cryptocurrencies. The biggest breakthrough that the patent gives to the network is its elimination of latency when it comes to bitcoin transactions. This allows for fasterbitcoin transactions– which is the main barrier to a lot of bitcoin payments. Square does this maintaining its own blockchain network that keeps a record of transactions that are then sent to the public blockchain. This transfers the risk of double spend attacks from the merchant to Square, encouraging merchants to take the risks. Another method by which transaction latency is eliminated is by having user funds held by Square, with Square updating its internal ledgers instead of referring to the external blockchain. However, a patent approval does not mean that Square will be implementing the system any time soon. Other companies have applied for crypto payment patents and have done nothing with them. For example,Bank of Americahas a number of them but the bank does not seem to be planning to use any of them. Square could be different in this regard because CEOJack Dorseyis a big fan of cryptocurrencies and he may want to push for a quick implementation. In a statement, Dorsey said The internet deserves a native currency. It will have a native currency. I don’t know if it will be Bitcoin or not. I hope it will be bitcoin Dorsey also says that Square’s interest in Bitcoin goes beyond just buying and selling it. The Square Cash app already features bitcoin trading, adding a cryptocurrency payment system to the app is a good move if Square really wants to promote bitcoin usage. news_title: Japan's FSA Responds To Reports of Crypto Current Law Changes
news_content: TheFinancial Services Agency(FSA) is Japan's highest authority when it comes to financial regulation. They are in charge of everything from stocks to cryptocurrencies. This is why the FSA has come under fire recently for being lax when it comes to regulating thecryptocurrency industryin the country. The FSA has noted that criticism hurled at them and is reportedly making changes in regulation to address the cryptocurrency industry. Currently, cryptocurrencies are managed under the revised fund settlement law. The FSA has plans to change this according to reports and will look to move it under theFinancial Instruments and Exchange Act(FIEA). This currently places cryptocurrencies as means of settlement since it is considered similar to electronic money. However, if the FSA does shift to it to the FIEA, it will no longer be considered a financial product similar to stocks and bonds. This shift can make it more complicated for cryptocurrency exchanges. Under the FIEA, companies are supposed to separate company funds from customer funds and to implement stricter protection systems to ensure that everything is legal and above board. However, these reports on the changes seem to be premature. After contacting the FSA, the agency commented that there were no plans for such changes. In a statement, the FSA said If there are such considerations, it will be taken up as an agenda for the study group the said agenda has not been discussed at all in the past 4 meetings…Things that are not on the agenda at all cannot be considered The FSA refers to the regular research meeting with experts in the crypto industry, wherein important issues are brought up and discussed. However, there is still a legitimate need for a stricter cryptocurrency law. The current revised fund settlement law is what allows cryptocurrency businesses to operate in Japan, with16 exchanges registered with the FSA. But with the recent Coincheck hack, scrutiny has increased over the cryptocurrency industry and its operators. An example of this would be the recent business improvement orders sent toTech BureauandGMO Cointo improve their internal systems for better protection. This was quickly followed by an additional sixbusiness improvement ordersto licensed exchanges. This includedBitflyer, which is currently Japan's largest bitcoin exchange. Incidents like these are part of the reason why the FSA has been criticized for its approval process on licensing crypto exchanges. Many hope that stricter laws would help improve security and safety in these licensed crypto exchanges and provide better protection to Japanese investors. news_title: France’s ‘Mister Bitcoin’ Says Crypto Providers Should Be Regulated
news_content: At present,there exist over 1,500 individual cryptocurrencies, and the number continues to increase by the week. This is because the knowledge of creating one’s own cryptocurrency has become so widespread that anyone with sufficient know-how can do it. This overabundance of cryptocurrency, of course, means that the vast majority of them will end up worthless – or at least, not as relevant as the leading cryptocurrencies. That leaves us with the question: what’s to become of these major cryptocurrencies, and of the medium as a whole?Jean-Pierre Landau, Deputy Governor of the Banque de France from 2006 to 2011, stated in a report to the French Ministry of Finance and Economy that the future of cryptocurrency would likely boil down into one of two outcomes: either it would degenerate and become marginalized, or worse, become extinct entirely; or experience what he calls a ‘Darwinian natural selection’ that would decide which of the major players in cryptocurrency attains dominance. In 2014, Landau made a critical comment about cryptocurrency, telling theFinancial Timesthat it was the21st century equivalent of the tulip(which was once used as a currency due to its phenomenally high price) and advised the people of Europe and the world at large to be wary of it. In January 2018, however, the Ministry of Finance and Economy had appointed Landau to look into the matter further and asked him to come up with his own regulations on the medium. Since this appointment, Landau had changed his tone about the issue saying that direct regulation would hamper the proactive development of an ‘evolving technology’ and that public policies should be built around avoiding that. Now known as ‘Mister Bitcoin‘, Landau goes on to say that policies should produce a conducive environment for the growth of cryptocurrency. ifo Institut InLandau’s reportto the Ministry of Finance and Economy, he said that the rarity of cryptocurrency transactions, the most common beingBitcoin accounted for only 0.2% of all transactions in Europe. This was caused by the decentralization of the medium which requires an inefficient and expensive verification method to be carried out. This creates a potentially permanent disadvantage for the cryptocurrency as according Landau states that it is impossible to marry decentralization and efficiency within the context of a monetary medium. Landau advises that regulations should not be set in stone at this point in time as the cryptocurrency process is still evolving and yet to be fully identified. Regulation, in his view, should be fully reserved for the parties making use of the product and not the product itself. news_title: Thailand SEC Issues Regulations For Crypto Exchanges & ICOs
news_content: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Thailand has provided the guidelines for trading cryptocurrencies. All cryptocurrency exchanges and related business must adhere to the rules stipulated by the regulator by the end of June. The rules framed by the monitoring agency are intended to govern both trading and investments in cryptocurrencies in Thailand. Furthermore, all businesses which handle cryptocurrencies in some form or the other must apply for a new license from the regulator. The SEC, Thailand permits the official trading of ICOs. However, the tokens are allowed to be exchanged only for seven cryptocurrencies. They areBitcoin (BTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), XRP (Ripple), Ethereum (ETH), Stellar (XLM), and Litecoin (LTC).The seven currencies were chosen based on consensus credibility and liquidity. The SEC believes that 5-10 exchanges will apply for a license in the forthcoming weeks. Either dealers or brokerage firms which are actively involved in cryptocurrency business is expected to apply for a license. Despite the relaxations, Thai regulator is determined to preserve the safeguard its domestic currency. The regulator has clearly ruled out the possibility of trading cryptos against fiat currencies in the country. The last date to apply for a license is August 14, which represents a 90 day deadline from the date of announcement by the SEC. A sum of 5 million Baht (~$157,000) is required as an upfront fee and only companies which are registered in Thailand are allowed to apply. All licensed cryptocurrency exchanges must pay an annual fee of 0.002% on the total trading volume. Brokerage firms must pay an annual fee of 0.001% on the annual trading volume. A minimum fee of 500,000 Baht and 250,000 Baht must be paid by a cryptocurrency exchange and brokerage firm, respectively. The maximum fee is limited to 20 million Baht and 5 million Baht. As far as ICOs are concerned the SEC has stated that each ICO should clearly mention the type of tokens being issued, along with complete investment information. There is no ceiling on the number of tokens which can be granted to institutional and ultra-high net worth investors. However, for an individual investor, an investment cap of 300,000 Baht is applicable and it should not constitute more than 70% of the total value of offered tokens. The guidelines may become the reference source to regulators in other countries. news_title: Chainlink Unveils CRE: Boosting Blockchain Scalability and Customization
news_content: Chainlink has introduced a transformative upgrade called the Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE), a new platform designed to scale operations across thousands of blockchain networks while providing developers with flexible and customizable workflows. The update, shared through Chainlink’s official X account, represents a step forward in modular blockchain design by breaking down essential oracle functions into adaptable components, allowing developers to create more specialized workflows suited to individual application requirements. The CRE offers a modular and composable architecture that enables developers to tap into Chainlink’s capabilities in unique ways. By separating the fundamental functions of an oracle network—such as blockchain reading and API calling—into distinct modules, Chainlink allows developers to integrate these functions based on their specific project needs. This architecture forms the foundation of Chainlink’s ecosystem, centralizing its capabilities in a way that allows for innovative workflows triggered by decentralized oracle networks (DONs) to securely facilitate interactions across various blockchain environments. An especially appealing aspect of CRE is its support for self-serve product development. Through this upgrade, developers can design applications and processes on the platform without needing to embed specialized Chainlink code into core blockchain computations. This makes cross-blockchain communication and transactions easier for developers to implement and enhances the platform’s usability, particularly for teams seeking a more seamless way to manage cross-chain data flows and interactions. In addition to fostering more customized development, CRE’s architecture accommodates programmatic workflows, which can be adjusted for specific blockchain applications. The platform also supports standard programming languages and tools, along with standardized cross-chain components, making it more accessible for a broader audience of developers. This cross-chain functionality opens new avenues for applications that benefit from diverse blockchain networks while maintaining ease of interaction.  Introducing Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE)—a major platform upgrade: 🔌 New modular, composable architecture⛓️ Scalable across 1000s of chains🏦 Deep customization for capital markets users🏗️ Self-serve product development 🧵⬇️https://t.co/BE807PgfB2 — Chainlink (@chainlink)October 30, 2024  To protect the user experience, Chainlink has structured the CRE upgrade as a phased rollout. This staggered approach will help the platform maintain continuity for current users throughout the transition. In the initial phase, Chainlink will focus on migrating key services such as the Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) to the CRE foundation. This move is expected to strengthen Chainlink’s cross-chain infrastructure, allowing for more seamless scalability as additional blockchains are integrated. As part of this upgrade, Chainlink has also introduced new blockchain integrations, including support for the Aptos blockchain. This enhanced architecture allows financial institutions to connect their existing systems with blockchain-based workflows, such as Delivery vs. Payment (DvP). By joining the early access program for CRE, users interested in exploring workflow creation on this platform can contribute to Chainlink’s growing network of cross-chain applications. The CRE upgrade thus not only benefits current users but also extends Chainlink’s reach into sectors looking for advanced interoperability solutions. Chainlink’s introduction of CRE is a significant leap forward for both the platform and its users. By providing a flexible, modular environment that facilitates blockchain interactions across various networks, CRE underscores Chainlink’s commitment to scalability and innovation within the blockchain space. This update, with its emphasis on modular design and cross-chain capabilities, positions Chainlink as a leading solution for developers seeking interoperability without compromising on customization or security. Ultimately, the Chainlink Runtime Environment stands as a promising development in blockchain technology, allowing developers to build applications that cater to diverse, decentralized workflows while simplifying the complexities of cross-chain data exchange. Through CRE, Chainlink continues to evolve as a platform that enables not only decentralized finance but also a broader ecosystem of blockchain-powered applications tailored to specific business and industry requirements. news_title: Instruxi Launches Mesh ID to Simplify Secure Access to Tokenized Assets
news_content: Instruxi, an emerging decentralized data management platform, has introduced Mesh ID, its latest Web3 solution aimed at revolutionizing access to tokenized Real-World Assets (RWAs) for over 22 million U.S. residents. This innovative tool is designed to simplify identity verification processes, enhance data privacy, and improve user accessibility to blockchain-based financial products in a way that aligns with regulatory requirements. Instruxi has collaborated with prominent industry players, including Chainlink, CLEAR, and Space and Time, to launch the Mesh ID solution as the initial module of its RWA platform. This collaboration, announced via a recent press release, leverages each partner’s strengths to optimize identity verification and provide robust data security for blockchain applications. Mesh ID integrates with CLEAR’s advanced API, enabling streamlined know-your-customer (KYC) processing without compromising user privacy or security. With CLEAR’s established track record of serving over 25 million users, Instruxi’s solution stands to benefit from a reputable, tier-one identity verification system. The Instruxi-CLEAR partnership facilitates faster pre-approval and minimizes KYC processing times, ultimately making on-chain financial products more accessible to U.S.-based users while ensuring regulatory compliance. In addition to CLEAR, Chainlink brings substantial value to Instruxi’s platform. As a leading decentralized computing platform, Chainlink supports Mesh ID’s seamless integration with enterprise systems, offering both on-chain and off-chain security assurances. Chainlink’s extensive suite of Oracle services has been pivotal in enabling secure data interactions, a key factor in asset tokenization’s projected $867 trillion market potential. Instruxi employs Chainlink Functions to enable access to real-world data via APIs and utilizes Chainlink Automation to ensure efficient, scalable operations within a decentralized framework. Further strengthening Mesh ID’s infrastructure, Instruxi has collaborated with Space and Time, a decentralized data warehouse for blockchain applications. Space and Time’s zero-knowledge database enables users to verify elements of their data and identity without exposing sensitive details on-chain. This feature enhances security while facilitating privacy-conscious access to RWAs, aligning with Instruxi’s mission to uphold data confidentiality as a cornerstone of its offerings. Austin Przybysz, Instruxi’s Co-Founder and Solutions Architect, highlighted the importance of the Mesh ID beta release, noting that this collaboration integrates KYC and identity verification within Instruxi Data Mesh to enable universal policy enforcement capabilities across the platform. He underscored the significance of combining high standards of user security with regulatory compliance to broaden accessibility to tokenized assets in a seamless, compliant manner. With the launch of Mesh ID, Instruxi is positioning itself at the forefront of asset tokenization, starting with tokenized real estate assets for its closed beta users. As the platform moves toward its full release, the company plans to expand its asset offerings to include additional classes, aligning with its goal to make a broad range of tokenized RWAs available through a user-centric, decentralized platform. Real-World Assets, or RWAs, refer to digital tokens that represent traditional financial assets, including cash, securities, commodities, and real estate, on the blockchain. By converting these assets into blockchain-based tokens, users gain new benefits such as fractional ownership, programmability, enhanced liquidity, transparency, and improved risk management. This emerging sector is gaining traction, with projections estimating a valuation of $10 trillion by 2030. Instruxi’s Mesh ID release signals a step toward a future where blockchain technology provides enhanced access to real-world financial assets in a way that preserves data privacy, streamlines verification processes, and ensures regulatory compliance. Through collaborations with industry leaders like Chainlink, CLEAR, and Space and Time, Instruxi demonstrates a commitment to creating an ecosystem where decentralized finance and real-world assets can coexist securely and efficiently. With Mesh ID’s launch, the platform takes a crucial step toward transforming how users interact with and access tokenized assets, setting a promising course for the future of Web3 applications in asset management. news_title: Morph Launches on Ethereum, Targeting Mass Blockchain Adoption
news_content: Morph, a globally recognized platform for advancing blockchain adoption, has officially launched its mainnet on Ethereum, a significant development in its journey toward creating a blockchain experience that is accessible to mainstream users. The launch of the Morph mainnet introduces a consumer layer designed to overcome common adoption barriers by enabling participants to trade real assets and engage in various blockchain transactions. With the mainnet now live, projects already developed on Morph can seamlessly transition to this broader ecosystem, potentially increasing user engagement and accelerating the platform’s consumer-focused growth. CEO and co-founder Cecilia Hsueh emphasized that this mainnet launch is a major achievement in Morph’s goal to bring blockchain technology to a broad audience. She indicated that most decentralized applications (DApps) are currently inaccessible to everyday users and stated that Morph’s objective is to bridge this gap by providing a decentralized, scalable, and secure infrastructure. This will enable developers to create the next generation of user-friendly DApps and offer non-crypto natives the opportunity to interact easily within the blockchain ecosystem. Morph’s consumer layer is a comprehensive environment combining advanced blockchain technologies, such as optimistic and zero-knowledge (ZK) rollups, which improve both security and scalability. The solution is crafted to address longstanding issues in blockchain, including regulatory restrictions, scalability limitations, and performance challenges. With these improvements, Morph is striving to make blockchain accessible to a wider user base by offering builders an experience that prioritizes scalability, security, and simplicity. Morph’s mainnet debut builds on the successes of its earlier Holesky testnet, which featured several key upgrades that have been integrated into the mainnet. One notable advancement was the EIP-4844 Optimistic zkVM integration, a feature that reduces transaction costs and offers an updated bridge mechanism allowing for single-transaction withdrawals. During the testnet phase, Morph recorded substantial engagement, with over six million wallet addresses, more than 100 million transactions, 200 projects deployed, and over one million community members. This high level of activity highlights the network’s appeal to developers and users alike and lays a strong foundation for further adoption on the mainnet. COO and co-founder Azeem Khan highlighted that Morph’s goal is to be a comprehensive resource for global builders, providing them with tools to help them achieve success in launching and scaling their blockchain projects. He pointed out that while decentralization is critical, builders face challenges in finding the resources needed for successful project development, launch, and expansion. Morph aims to address this gap by creating an environment tailored to the needs of builders, thereby facilitating a more accessible path to blockchain success. Morph distinguishes itself from other blockchain platforms by prioritizing a consumer-focused approach rather than remaining limited to purely technical features. This consumer layer strategy involves offering critical resources to builders, including funding, incubation, acceleration, and market strategies, all aimed at fostering a user-first approach to blockchain development. Among its initiatives, Morph recently launched the Centralized Exchange Coalition, which includes several leading centralized exchanges, to empower builders with the tools necessary to bring projects to market, attract new users, and secure essential funding. Through these supportive measures, Morph seeks to position itself as a significant driver of blockchain innovation and adoption, facilitating a new wave of user-friendly applications that can appeal to a broad audience. This support system aligns with Morph’s overarching vision of transforming the blockchain industry from a niche technological space to an accessible mainstream utility. By equipping builders with the necessary resources, Morph aims to generate a broad ecosystem of applications that meet diverse user needs and contribute to increased blockchain adoption. Morph operates as a global consumer layer, serving as a distribution hub that provides builders with the resources needed to launch and scale their projects for the mass market. Through the use of hybrid rollup technology, combining ZK and Optimistic rollups, and employing a decentralized sequencer, Morph opens up limitless possibilities for developers targeting a mainstream audience. This unique blend of technology allows Morph to offer a user-friendly experience for developers who seek to create accessible and secure blockchain applications. As one of Morph’s original investors, Bitget, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, will continue to play a role in supporting the Morph ecosystem and contributing to its growth. With these strategic partnerships and innovative technologies, Morph is positioned to make a significant impact on the blockchain industry by paving the way for consumer-friendly, scalable applications that cater to everyday users. By emphasizing accessibility, resource support, and advanced technology, Morph aims to transform the blockchain landscape and drive a new era of blockchain adoption for all. news_title: Cryptocurrency ICO - Current & Upcoming ICOs Reviewed and Rated by CoinTrust.com
news_content: An ICO is a fund-raising mechanismcontrivance where a start-up sells their existing cryptocurrency tokens for either Bitcoin or Ether. The investors get a share in the start-up. The inception of the ICO trend dates back to 2013, where it all began for the ICOs. The pre-developed tokens are then available for the people to trade onall the Cryptocurrency exchanges, given that there’s decent demand for that particular token. With the growing ICO trend, many start-ups are coming forward with their innovative ideas and business plans to raise the funds they require to execute their business. Investors from all around the globe are getting interested in ICOs because they usually provide investors with a lot of money making opportunities. The triumph of Ethereum ICO led to a lot more well-planned ICO projects that followed the path of Ethereum. ICOs have the potential to completely change the way businesses work. They’re already making huge improvements in the fundraising sector. The riseof cryptocurrencieshas completely changed the face of both the tech and financial industries. Blockchain has paved way for many innovations in both of these fields. While everyone is busy looking at the Bitcoin and a few other major Altcoins, there is a growing number of newer coins being introduced into circulation with different features and advantages. ICOs are happening every other day for one new altcoin or the other and altcoins are constantly outdoing each other in terms of improvising and providing the best features. TheBitcoinmay be the most popular and valuable cryptocoin at this point, but you can rest assured that there are newer altcoins coming out regularly which offer everything the bitcoin does and even more.The way that these altcoins are initially introduced to the market is through what is known as an ICO – Initial Coin Offering. The big crypto investors are actively getting into the ICOs by investing good amounts of money into several promising ICOs. Unfortunately, a few isolated events that occurred with regards to ICOs has resulted in people giving it a bad reputation. We should take a step away from it and realize that these are just few bad apples. Even these incidents have not been able to stop the ICO train, as it is still moving forward successfully with many more upcoming ICO projects. Basically, one needs to be careful while getting involved with any type of financial instrument, let alone an ICO. Proper education about the business model goes a long way in helping you make the right decisions from an investment stand point. As mentioned earlier, an ICO works in a very similar way to theIPOmodel. A start-up company or team comes up with a business plan which has a cryptocurrency coin integrated into it. The start-up creates cryptocurrency tokens which will be made available for the investors to buy. The ICO is developed with the backing of a blockchain-based software or frameworksuch asEthereum. Then the whole mechanism is supported by digital tokens which are cryptography-based. These digital tokens are usually known as tokens or coins. The team then comes up with a white paper, which is basically a statement that includes all the details of their project and their business model. You can find all the technical details of an ICO in theirwhite paper. The companies that offers products and services by integrating a crypto token or coin can only be labeled as an ICO. With an ICO, start-up companies can raise the required capital for their business in a very easy and simple way. The investor who buys the coins or tokens gets profited if the company performs well in the post ICO period. The coins/tokens are then introduced into the cryptocurrency exchanges, where the public investors can trade them. The initial investors’ profits depend on the value of the coin after it gets introduced to the cryptocurrency exchanges. The people who invest in the ICO phase usually get a decent discount on the price of coins. By now, you may have understood what an ICO is and how it works. Now, it’s time to get educated about our ICO reviewing process in order to make sure that you’re investing properly. Currently, there’s a backlash against ICOs due to some scams that happenedin the recent past. The cryptocurrency community strives hard to eradicate such things from happening in the future. If you’re interested in investing some of your money in the ICOs, you must educate yourself about the major factors that determine an ICO. If you invest blindly into an ICO, you might regret later if it turns out to be either a scam or a bad project. Investing in the already-established cryptocurrencies is fairly easy when compared to the upcoming cryptocurrency projects in the form of ICOs. The process can be really tricky since we can’t really see what lies behind the fancy whitepaper and the ICO promotions. In order to find andfilter the best ICO projects out there, you need to completely understand the dynamics of ICO projects and the way they’re marketed and executed. Currently, there are lots of ICO projects that are being announced and marketed within the cryptocurrency community. It can be a little complicated to find out the best and efficient ICO projects for you to invest in. To do the job properly, you should properly educate yourself about the different methods of reviewing an ICO project. These include various factors concerning about different mechanisms of an ICO project. By practicing these methods thoroughly while checking out and reviewing an ICO project can help you by leaps and bounds.Following are a few steps that you can take while reviewing an ICO: This is the most important step while assessing an ICO project. A good team most probably is capable of executing the ICO properly. Try to research about the team members that are involved in the ICO you’re considering. You can use Linkedin for this purpose since most of the developers and entrepreneurs are active on this social media platform.Googlethe names of the team members and try to find as much information as possible about them. Look up their past projects and their portfolio to get an idea about them. Make sure to check out if the team had any previous experience related to cryptocurrencies. Check their credentials and educational backgrounds to ensure they’re appropriately qualified. If their information is not available anywhere on the internet, then it’s a big red flag for you to proceed. Usually, the people who hide their portfolios tend to be on the wrong side of the line when it comes to legitimacy. So, finding as much information as you can about the team should be of high priority to you. If the team has any prior crypto experience, find out what projects they have worked on and whether the projects have succeeded or not. If the team worked on a project which ended up a failure, you must consider backing out. Talk to the team behind the ICO and ask them any queries that you may have. If the team is not responsive or unclear with the answers, it’s not a very good sign. Most of the ICO projects have public communities on different social media platforms or messengers. Usually, the majority of ICO teams and communities use Slack andTelegramto communicate with each other. These platforms are used for the general chit-chat and some important updates about the project. ICO teams deliver their messages to the community through Slack and Telegram. The community members are able to participate in group chats and private chats with the other community members and the ICO team members. Make sure that you search for the public communities of an ICO while considering it as a potential investment. Some ICO projects go with unlimited capitalization, which you need to consider seriously.ICO projects that have unlimited capitalization lets the investors send in as much money as they can. news_title: FTX's Nishad Singh Gets No Prison Time for Role in Crypto Exchange Collapse
news_content: Election 2024 coverage presented by NEW YORK – Nishad Singh, former director of engineering at FTX and a one-time member of Sam Bankman-Fried’s inner circle, was sentenced to time served by a federal judge on Wednesday, meaning he's not going to prison like his former colleagues. He was also ordered to pay $11 billion in restitution. Singh, 29, who pleaded guilty to six criminal counts including wire fraud and conspiracy in February, is the fourth FTX executive to be sentenced for his role in the fraud. Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in prison in March for his role as ringleader. Former FTX Digital Markets CEO Ryan Salame, who did not testify against Bankman-Fried, recently began serving his 7.5 year prison sentence. And Caroline Ellison, former Alameda Research CEO and one-time girlfriend of Bankman-Fried, wassentenced to two yearsby the same judge, District Judge Lewis Kaplan of the Southern District of New York (SDNY), last month – her sentence heavily discounted by her prompt and extensive cooperation with prosecutors. Though Kaplan sounded sympathetic to Ellison during her sentencing last month, he contrasted her long-time involvement in and awareness of Bankman-Fried's fraud with Singh, who was out of the loop until only two months before the exchange collapsed. "Your case is not the case that Miss Ellison's was. She was involved from the beginning. She knew for years," Kaplan said before handing down the sentence. Kaplan and prosecutors highlighted Singh's extensive cooperation with prosecutors, during which he incriminated himself repeatedly and informed the government of crimes they did not yet know about. While Singh did promptly cooperate with the prosecution after FTX collapsed – as well as the FTX bankruptcy estate, as highlighted in an Oct. 29 letter from current FTX CEO John J. Ray III to the court – includingtestifying against his childhood-friendin Bankman-Fried’s trial last October, he admitted he knew of the $8 billion hole in FTX’s balance sheet by September 2022, two months before the exchange collapsed. Despite knowing about the disastrous financial situation at FTX, Singh also went through with the purchase of a $3.7 million estate in Washington's Orcas Island in October of 2022, which his lawyer, Andrew Goldstein of Cooley LLP, described as a "deep mistake." Wednesday's sentence was surely welcome news to Singh and his legal team, who requested that the former FTX executive serve no prison time. In a court filing earlier this month, Singh’s lawyers urged the court to consider his “limited” involvement in the scheme, as well as his cooperation with the prosecutions of Bankman-Fried and Salame. The filing described him as an“uncommonly selfless individual”and attached more than 100 letters from friends and family. More than 20 friends and family members – including Singh's fiancee Claire Watanabe, his parents and his younger brother – attended the sentencing on Wednesday. Watanabe gasped with relief at the news that Singh would not be going to prison. Both parents shed tears. Before Kaplan dismissed the court, he spoke to Singh's parents, emphasizing that he was speaking from his personal perspective and not as a judge. "I don't see anything you did wrong," Kaplan said. When crypto prices are up, firms in the space tend to be fatter due to bigger profits, with layoffs more likely during prolonged bear markets. Consensys founder Joseph Lubinsaidin a statement Tuesday that part of the reason for the layoffs was “ongoing regulatory uncertainty” and “many millions of dollars” spent as a result of legal cases. The company has faced a number of legal battles with Wall Street’s biggest regulator, the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Kraken is another crypto company that has locked horns with the watchdog: Last year, the company agreed topaythe SEC a $30 million fine and halt its cryptocurrency staking service for U.S. clients, following a lawsuit from the regulator. news_content: Share Kraken reportedly fired 15% of its workforce, according to two individuals with insider knowledge, as reported by a New York Times journalist.
